title: RH Recalls Furniture Due to Injury, Laceration Hazards
summary: The metal trim on the furniture can detach from the edges and create sharp points, posing injury and laceration hazards. Units: About 9,400 (in addition, about 300 were sold in Canada).

title: Richie House Children's Robes Recalled by Belle Investment Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard; Sold Exclusively at Amazon.com
summary: The children's robes fail to meet federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 1,500.

title: Fred's Recalls Charcoal Grills Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The exterior paint on the grill can ignite, posing a fire hazard. Units: 2000.

title: Sweet Bamboo Recalls Children's Pajamas Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The children's pajamas fail to meet the federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 500.

title: MixBin Electronics Recalls iPhone Cases Due to Risk of Skin Irritation and Burns
summary: Liquid and glitter can leak out of the cases, causing skin irritation and burns to consumers. Units: About 263,000 (in addition, 11, 400 were sold in Canada and 400 in Mexico).

title: Panelcraft Recalls Children's Building Sets Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The building sets corner welds can break, allowing the panels and frames to separate and release magnets during play. When released, exposed magnets can create a choking hazard. Units: About 2,000.

title: FedEx Supply Chain Recalls Cellphone Batteries That Could Lead to Fire and Burn Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The cellphone battery can overheat, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 10,200 batteries.

title: BRIO Recalls Baby Rattles Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The wooden rings on the hammer rattles can crack, posing a choking hazard to children. Units: About 1,500 (in addition, about 190 rattles were sold in Canada).

title: Dan Post Boot Company Recalls Safety Boots and Shoes Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The boots and shoes can fail to protect feet when heavy or sharp objects fall on them, posing an injury hazard to consumers. Units: About 7,200.

title: Laura Ashley Girl's Dresses Recalled by Pastourelle Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The flower petals can detach, posing a choking hazard to children. Units: About 2,800.

title: Kawasaki Recalls All-Terrain Vehicles Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The fuel tap can leak, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 15,000.

title: Meijer Recalls Children's Swimsuits Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The snaps on the swimsuit can detach, posing a choking hazard to the child. Units: About 22,200.

title: NVIDIA Recalls European Plug Heads Sold with Power Adaptors Due to Electric Shock Hazard
summary: The plug heads can break exposing metal prongs, posing an electric shock hazard. Units: About 6,900 (in addition, about 360 were sold in Canada).

title: Polaris Recalls Scrambler All-Terrain Vehicles Due to Crash Hazard
summary: The throttle release switch can fail, posing a crash hazard. Units: 2800.

title: Firewood Recalls Vaporizers Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: An electrical short can occur in the vaporizer, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 400.

title: Hallmark Recalls Plush Baby Stacking Toys Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The toys have fabric hats and bows that can detach, posing a choking hazard. Units: About 5,800 (in addition, about 200 were sold in Canada).

title: Dr. Brown's Natural Bottle & Dish Soaps Recalled by Handi-Craft Company Due to Risk of Bacteria Exposure
summary: The bottle and dish soap can contain harmful bacteria. Exposure to bacteria poses a risk of respiratory and other infections in immunocompromised individuals. Units: About 23,000.

title: Fabri-Tech Recalls Infant Rompers Due to Choking Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Cracker Barrel Old Country Stores
summary: The buttons on the shoulder straps can detach, posing a choking hazard to children. Units: About 6,500.

title: Arc'teryx Recalls Ski Mountaineering Boots Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The axis pin located at the rear of the boot can dislodge, resulting in damage to the boot and posing a fall hazard. Units: About 3,900 (in addition, about 500 were sold in Canada).

title: Dr. Martens Vegan Boots Recalled by Airwair Due to Chemical Exposure Hazard
summary: Prolonged and direct contact with the boot tongue lining can expose the wearer to the chemical benzidine. Units: About 30,000 (in addition, about 900 in Canada).

title: Academy Sports + Outdoors Recalls Crawfish Kits with Strainer Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The crawfish kit hose can melt and/or burn, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 21,000 (in addition, about 17 were sold in Canada).

title: Nutrilife Recalls Bottles of Hydrogen Peroxide Due to Fire, Burn Hazards
summary: The bottle caps on the 29% hydrogen peroxide one-gallon bottles do not vent properly and can allow pressure to build up in the bottle and cause it to expand and rupture, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 11,800 (in addition, about 3,500 in Canada).

title: Polaris Recalls GENERAL Recreational Off-Highway Vehicles Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: Inconsistent tire pressure information can result in improperly-inflated tires, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 1,600.
